set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess
out={"schema":"PROJECT_BRAIN_LOCAL_CAPABILITY_PROBE_V1","candidates":[]}
for name in ("tesseract","pdftoppm","pdftotext"):
    path=shutil.which(name)
    rec={"name":name,"path":path}
    if path:
        raw=pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()
        rec["sha256"]=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        p=subprocess.run([path,"--version"] if name=="tesseract" else [path,"-v"],text=True,capture_output=True)
        rec["version_output"]=(p.stdout+p.stderr)[:4000]
        pkg=subprocess.run(["dpkg-query","-S",path],text=True,capture_output=True)
        rec["package_owner"]=pkg.stdout.strip()[:1000]
    out["candidates"].append(rec)
path=pathlib.Path("canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-CAPABILITY-DISCOVERY-LOCAL-OCR-001__PROBE.json")
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print("LOCAL_OCR_PROBE_COMPLETE")
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY
